from math import gcd

def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    # prefix sums P[i] = sum of first i elements; subarray (i, j) has
    # sum P[j]-P[i] and length j-i. We want max slope (P[j]-P[i])/(j-i)
    # over pairs with j-i >= k.
    P = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, v in enumerate(a):
        P[i + 1] = P[i] + v

    # Upper convex hull of prefix points (x = index, y = P[index]),
    # x strictly increasing, consecutive slopes strictly decreasing.
    hull = []

    def slope2(o, p, q):
        # sign of slope(o->p) - slope(o->q) via cross product (exact)
        return (p[0] - o[0]) * (q[1] - o[1]) - (p[1] - o[1]) * (q[0] - o[0])

    def add_point(idx):
        p = (idx, P[idx])
        while len(hull) >= 2:
            o = hull[-2]
            m = hull[-1]
            # pop m if slope(o->m) <= slope(m->p), i.e. m is below chord o->p
            # cross(o,m,p) = (m.x-o.x)*(p.y-o.y) - (m.y-o.y)*(p.x-o.x)
            # slope(o->m) <= slope(m->p)  <=>  cross(o,m,p) >= 0
            if (m[0] - o[0]) * (p[1] - o[1]) - (m[1] - o[1]) * (p[0] - o[0]) >= 0:
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(p)

    best_num = 0   # best sum
    best_den = 1   # best length

    for j in range(k, n + 1):
        add_point(j - k)
        X = j
        Y = P[j]
        # find hull vertex maximizing (Y - y)/(X - x); f is unimodal
        lo, hi = 0, len(hull) - 1
        h = hull
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            m1 = h[mid]
            m2 = h[mid + 1]
            f1_num = Y - m1[1]
            f1_den = X - m1[0]
            f2_num = Y - m2[1]
            f2_den = X - m2[0]
            if f1_num * f2_den < f2_num * f1_den:
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid
        i = h[lo][0]
        num = P[j] - P[i]
        den = j - i
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num, best_den = num, den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
